mapper.select: SELECT ics02_manager_id AS manager_id, ics02_manager_group_nm AS manager_group_name, ics02_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(ics02_person_id) AS person_name, ics02_note AS note, COALESCE(ics02_default_yn, 'false') AS default_yn FROM icr05_relate_manager INNER JOIN ics02_manager ON icr05_manager_id = ics02_manager_id WHERE 1=1 AND icr05_company_id = #{companyId} AND icr05_icr_class_tree_id = #{icrClassTreeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO icr05_relate_manager ( icr05_relate_manager_id, icr05_company_id, icr05_icr_class_tree_id, icr05_manager_id ) VALUES ( f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{icrClassTreeId}, #{managerId} )
